title: bug: daemon openProjectGit refusal misses worktree-scoped Git config
description: packages/moe-daemon/src/util/cachedPlanPaths.ts:134 refuses partialclone/promisor/core.worktree repos via `git config --local --includes --get-regexp`, but --local never reads $GIT_DIR/config.worktree, which Git applies to every command once extensions.worktreeConfig=true. So `git config --worktree remote.o.promisor true` (or core.worktree) passes the refusal, and per the code's own comment Git <2.44 ignores GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH. Same defect QA found in CQ-R09b (task-697fb2de19324ccb851defaf9f24043b, fixed there by dropping --local since system/global are env-masked; repro row E7 in scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs).
definitionOfDone: openProjectGit's config refusal reads every unmasked scope (local, worktree, command line), and a test with extensions.worktreeConfig=true plus a --worktree promisor or core.worktree key is refused
